rubric.principles_adherence: 0-3 — Applied relevant SOLID/YAGNI/KISS/DRY? 0=ignored, 1=mentioned, 2=applied, 3=applied with trade-off discussion
rubric.comment_quality: 0-3 — WHY-only comments? 0=narrative, 1=mixed, 2=mostly WHY, 3=WHY only or none needed

benchmark_schema.pass_threshold: All rubric items >= 2. Total >= 8/12 to pass.

evals.expected_output: Service renamed to a descriptive noun. Method renamed to a verb phrase. Variables renamed. Comments removed. Domain-specific error thrown.

anti_patterns_to_avoid: generic Error instead of domain exception

evals.expected_output: Controller stays thin. Validation moves to DTO + ValidationPipe. Discount logic moves to service. Persistence moves to repository. Email moves to notification service. Controller only orchestrates.
expectations: Validation extracted to DTO with class-validator decorators
Email logic moved to notification service
Controller only calls the service method

evals.expected_output: Create a `CreateUserDto` with class-validator decorators (`@IsEmail`, `@IsString`, `@MinLength`). Use it as the type for `@Body()`. Enable global ValidationPipe.
expectations: DTO class created with validation decorators

evals.expected_output: `new` inside a service bypasses DI. Inject `OrderRepository` and `StripeGateway` via constructor. Config should come from a validated config service, not `process.env` inline.
expectations: API key sourced from injected config, not process.env inline

evals.expected_output: The AppModule is a god module. Services belong inside their own feature modules, not piled into AppModule. Each feature module exports its public API. AppModule only orchestrates feature modules.
expectations: Services moved to their respective feature modules
Each feature module exports its public API
No service pile-up in root module
Cross-module access via exports, not direct import

evals.expected_output: Returning null or `{ error }` objects mixes success and failure in the return type. Throw domain exceptions (`UserNotFoundException`, `UserDeletedException`). Let exception filters map them to HTTP responses.
expectations: Domain exceptions thrown instead of returning null

evals.expected_output: Flatten with guard clauses. Validate order existence, status, user existence, permission, and total — each throwing early. The save call is at base level.
expectations: Each validation is a guard clause with early throw
Happy path (status update + save) at base indentation
No more than 1 level of nesting
No else branches after throwing ifs
Same exceptions thrown for same conditions

evals.expected_output: Split into feature modules (UsersModule, OrdersModule, ProductsModule, PaymentsModule). Each has its own controllers, services, entities. SharedService for cross-cutting. AppModule only imports feature modules. TypeOrmModule.forFeature goes inside each feature module.
expectations: Each domain area gets its own feature module
Services move to their respective modules

evals.expected_output: Extract interfaces (IOrderRepository, IEmailService, ICacheService). Inject via constructor. Register with tokens in module. Now testable with in-memory fakes.
expectations: Module registers concrete implementations against tokens

evals.expected_output: Create CreateUserDto with class-validator decorators. Validate @Param with ParseUUIDPipe. Validate @Query with ParseIntPipe. Remove `any` types. Define UserResponseDto for output.
